title: Customization scopes — standardise checkout review without overriding brand teams
feature: Devin customization scopes: root and nested AGENTS.md, AGENTS.local.md, .devin/rules trigger frontmatter (always_on, glob, manual, model_decision), repo and global skills, personal / organization / enterprise plugin scopes
prerequisites: Repo cloned locally, `npm install` done at the root, Node 22
Lab 00 done once, so you know how the voice coach works
Work on a throwaway branch such as `lab/03-<your-handle>`; never commit rules or skills from this lab to `main`
No database is needed: this lab changes instruction files only

matrix.fixture: `node labs/03-customization-scopes/solution/resolve.mjs --file <path> [--home /tmp/kade-home] [--mention <rule>]` lists which instruction files and rules would be in context for that path, which were skipped and why, conflicting statements and same-named skills
matrix.note: Models the documented loading rules; every behaviour the docs leave open is printed under `assumptions`

matrix.integration: Devin web app (Agent mode) or Devin CLI on your throwaway branch
matrix.fixture: Skip the live check; the resolver output is your evidence
matrix.note: With a live session, open `services/api/src/money.ts` and ask which rules and instruction files are in context; compare with the resolver

matrix.integration: Organization or enterprise Customize settings (plugins, rules, skills at org/enterprise scope)
matrix.fixture: Describe the layer in your scope matrix; do not change shared org settings for a lab
matrix.note: Editing those scopes needs org or enterprise settings access, which most learners do not have

matrix.integration: Devin web app (Agent mode) for the voice coach in section 8
matrix.fixture: Run the drill against a timer and self-score with the rubric in the answer
matrix.note: Coaching is always started by you; nothing is scheduled

credentials.fixture_only_story: Everything is offline: you write the shared checklist rule, the Trailhead rule, the repo skill and the ownership file on a throwaway branch, apply each injector, and keep the resolver JSON for `services/api/src/money.ts` and `services/api/src/routes/catalog.ts` before and after each fix as evidence. The sandbox home `/tmp/kade-home` stands in for your real home directory, so no global file on your machine is touched.
not_exercised: What a live Devin session actually loads for a given path — the resolver models the documented rules and labels its assumptions
Organization and enterprise scope changes in Customize settings — need admin access and would affect other people's sessions
Precedence between two loaded instructions that disagree — not stated in the docs; the lab resolves it by design (one owner, the rest defer) instead of relying on load order

scenarios.clean_state: `.devin/rules/` holds only `repo-conventions.md` and `money-and-brands.md`, there is no `.devin/skills/checkout-review/`, no `.github/CODEOWNERS`, no `AGENTS.local.md` at the root and no `services/api/src/AGENTS.md`, and `/tmp/kade-home` does not exist. `node labs/03-customization-scopes/solution/resolve.mjs --file services/api/src/money.ts` exits 0 and lists the root and `services/api` AGENTS.md files and the two existing rules.

injectors.name: nested-conflict
injectors.when: T+20 min, once your checklist and brand rule resolve cleanly
injectors.behaviour: Copy `labs/03-customization-scopes/injectors/nested-conflict.AGENTS.md` to `services/api/src/AGENTS.md`. A Platform engineer left notes one directory deeper that state the opposite tax presentation. Find out what is in context for `money.ts` now, and fix it without deleting the engineer's file.

injectors.name: local-override
injectors.behaviour: Copy `labs/03-customization-scopes/injectors/local-override.AGENTS.local.md` to `AGENTS.local.md` at the repo root. Find out who sees it, whether `git status` shows it and what happens to the checklist statement it contradicts.

injectors.name: wrong-glob
injectors.behaviour: Copy `labs/03-customization-scopes/injectors/trailhead-vat.wrong-glob.md` over `.devin/rules/trailhead-vat.md`. The Trailhead team rewrote their globs from memory. Check which files the rule now covers and correct it.

injectors.name: global-skill
injectors.behaviour: Create `/tmp/kade-home/.config/devin/skills/checkout-review/` and copy `labs/03-customization-scopes/injectors/global-skill.SKILL.md` into it as `SKILL.md`, then resolve with `--home /tmp/kade-home`. A reviewer's personal shortcut now has the same name as the team's procedure. Decide what to change and where.
